# Support (Internal)

This repository is for **internal Navflex use**. If you need help:

## 🧭 Where to ask

- **Development workflow & standards** — see the
  [Development Workflow](https://navflex.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/NDT/pages/305758257/Development+Workflow)
  documentation.
- **Feature or repository ownership** — check the
  [Sub-Teams](https://navflex.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/NDT/pages/247922704/Sub-Teams#Sub-Teams)
  page and contact the responsible tech lead.
- **Bugs and feature requests** — open a ClickUp ticket in the relevant list
  and link it from your issue or pull request.
- **CI / pipelines / self-hosted runners** — the quality suite and build
  pipelines are maintained centrally; questions and problems go to the
  infrastructure channel or the CI maintainers.

## 🔐 Security issues

Never discuss vulnerabilities in issues or public channels — follow
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead.
